fieldValues.title: Requests reach a group only through its input queue
fieldValues.decision_question: How does a request reach a working group?
fieldValues.context: D5 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A request reaches a group only through that group's input queue, never filed straight as ready work.
fieldValues.rationale: A group assesses against its queue, budget and local priorities only at its input queue (proposal section 3).
fieldValues.revisit_when: The falsifier in proposal section 7 fires.
